# Deel

Payroll and HR · options checked 2026-10-27 · [how sources are chosen](../../docs/SOURCING.md)

**Deel runs its own hosted server for AI agents. Start with that.**

Deel runs its own hosted MCP server. On GitHub, letsdeel/deel-cli is a general command-line client for Deel's API with no agent skills, and deel-public/deel-public-mcp could not be confirmed as Deel's and can issue off-cycle payments, so neither is indexed.

## Hosted by the vendor

- **https://api.letsdeel.com/mcp** — connect it in Claude as a custom connector (remote MCP server) and sign in with your Deel account. What it can change is not documented publicly.
  Not on GitHub, so this index cannot watch it for changes.

[`letsdeel`](https://github.com/letsdeel) on GitHub publishes no skills or MCP server for agents as of 2026-10-27. That is a dated fact, not a permanent one.
